references.text: Jesus' question "Where have you laid him?" triggers an emotional reaction in which he weeps, demonstrating his compassion and human grief over the death.
Jesus' question leads those present to comment on his love and sorrow, highlighting the personal relationship he had with the one who died.
The question about the burial place sparks a discussion about Jesus' ability to prevent death, pointing to his power over life and death.
Jesus' movement toward the tomb after the question shows his willingness to confront death directly and challenge it with his own power.
Jesus' command to remove the stone from the tomb is a direct result of the question about the burial place, marking the transition from grief to action.
